environment.description: Tomcat 9.0 on EC2 instance in public subnet, direct internet-facing via NLB (Layer 4, TCP passthrough). PostgreSQL 14 RDS in same VPC, DB_USER=report_admin with superuser privileges. No application firewall. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. RDS security group allows inbound from application SG on 5432.

config.db_views: v_report_sales, v_report_inventory, v_report_headcount are simple SELECT * views over base tables
